component.name: salesforce_raf
component.description: RAF companion for Extole for Salesforce — fires on advocate SHAREABLE events in marketing campaigns and dispatches writeback payloads to the configured Salesforce endpoint.

actions.webhook_id: javascript@buildtime:(function() { var children = Java.from(context.getComponent().getParent().getChildren()); for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) { var wh = Java.from(children[i].createElementsQuery().withType('WEBHOOK').withTag('internal:app_type=extole-sfdc-app').list()); if (wh && wh.length > 0) return wh[0].getId(); } return null; })()
